name: Malaika
description: Raspberry variety bred by Advanced Berry Breeding (ABB), part of ABB's tiered Elite Raspberry Collection (ERC) licensing platform. The Summer Berry Company (TSBC) signed a five-year deal with ABB to grow Malaika (and Zawadi) in Portugal, becoming the first Portuguese grower to hold a Gold License on ABB's ERC platform. Onubafruit separately grows Malaika in Spain (Huelva), expanding plantings to an estimated 150-200 hectares per Hortidaily -- a real, second, independent licensed-grower relationship for the same multi-licensee variety. Independently corroborated by AICEP, Fruitnet (two articles), Hort News, FreshFruitPortal.com, and Hortidaily.
